data.description:
Does It Stack? lets players create ridiculous towers by stacking an assortment of items atop one another. Play solo, or together in virtual- or augmented reality. Are you a stacking master or a stacking disaster?

{383171848203466}

# Create wacky towers
Can you build a tower of toy cars with a bicycle on top? Can you balance a fish on a bowling ball? Maybe this is the rare occasion where you should put the fork in the toaster? But watch out! If two objects of the same color touch each other, they go BOOM! Be careful, or you might get a heart-a-stack!

{1257651048587175}

# Play in augmented- or virtual reality
Choose between augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR). Immerse yourself in VR worlds or mix digital elements into your real surroundings with AR. The choice is yours!

{1474879109856394}

# Stack together in local co-op mode 
Stack solo or team up with friends in local co-op mode. Whether you prefer tackling challenges on your own or working together to solve puzzles, you can enjoy the fun your way—solo or with others, all in the same room.

{1517634328955115}

# Features 
- 60 levels with 3 challenges each
- 150 unlockable objects 
- Get creative with your unlocked items and gizmos in the sandbox mode
- Try to beat your friends' height scores
- Compete in the daily challenge mode
- You can use voice chat through Meta's People app

changelog.change_log:
Heyhoo Stackers, Patch 1.01 just went live!

The patch mostly consists of QoL improvements and bug fixes. You can find the complete list here: 

[Multiplayer]
- Added a confirm button to the disconnect flow
- Pedestal height now works in multiplayer
- Object no longer stick to your hands after exploding while being held by a client
- Fixed an issue where repeated connects and disconnects would leave the client believing they were the host

[UI]
- Height labels are not placed correctly above the pedestal in AR
- Removed the 'next level' button when completing the final level
- Added the level index to the title text in-level
- Fixed an issue with the welcome message
- Added extra text in the options to let players know that they can Press "A" anytime to move the table in AR

[Level]
- Stopped daily challenge from completing prematurely
- Daily challenge now uses the player selected measurement system
- Fixed infinite loading screen when trying to start the daily challenge while having no internet connection

[Objects]
- Object outlines are now only disabled above the pedestal

[Misc]
- Removed the Microphone permission check
- Set a limit on the amount of gizmos can be spawned in the main hub
- Set a limit on the amount of props can be spawned in the main hub
- Fixed placement of explosion button and confetti in AR

If you encounter issues, let us know on our Discord! (discord.gg/DYS2ZpvBfm)

Otherwise, happy Stacking and see you on the leaderboards!
